final:
type BadInput = { text: str }

sum_parsed(xs: List[str]) -> int fail BadInput =
  ex sum_parsed(["1", "2", "3"]) == 6
  var total = 0
  for s in xs
    let n = s.parse_int() else fail BadInput(text: copy s)
    total += n
  total
